answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake armies: each identity must trade with 20 distinct partners per epoch, at most 2 counted trades per pair, on a public graph. A velvet rope guards entry: each trade carries a violet stamp from a counterparty, while an agent whispering deals to its own clones fails the count. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 trades at $2 each: $40,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $2 once and keeps its share.
